items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: we went to Tom Schmauer's Green Mill Gardens with the show

ctx.x: 22 pieces? No, no, no, no. That band was cut out. Because you see we went to Tom Schmauer's Green Mill Gardens with the show. That's where we opened up at. Then when it came time to go on the road we brought the show in in the theater to get used to the stage and everything. And James P., a lot of his music we were using. Going through your- You were the pit band? Well, we were the pit band and we got up on the stage after intermission. Wow, what, ten, twelve pieces?
How many were you? What do you have? Wow. Wow.
